classification_legend.derived_spacing: scales with the preset spacing base (COMPLIANT)
classification_legend.derived_density: scales with density (EdgeInsetsDensity / resolveEdgeInsets / density-scaled literal) (COMPLIANT)
classification_legend.theme_default: resolved through a component theme / widget leg (COMPLIANT when its own default is density-derived)
classification_legend.computed: expression over parameters, not a literal (COMPLIANT)
classification_legend.border_hairline: 1px border or divider — allowed by the audit rules
classification_legend.icon_size: icon glyph size owned by the component theme — allowed
classification_legend.shadcn_fixed: size pinned by shadcn in a box context — allowed
classification_legend.layout_cap: width/height layout cap, not padding — allowed
classification_legend.raw: literal padding/gap/spacing that does not scale — FINDING
